meta.title: Ondra Relationship Stage
meta.description: Seven-stage relationship arc: hostile, probing, crush, possessive, pathological, sacrifice, settled. Four gates block stage jumps (time, 0.06 step cap, monotonic ratchet, conflict-lock override to hostile); the stage itself is a ratchet. Three relationship dimensions decay with 240h/720h/8760h half-lives and familiarity is derived from interaction count. The five-stage legacy view and the six-band 0-1000 scale are read-only derivations; pathological and sacrifice stay out of the default UI.
